snippet.title: Placebo - Helen Keller - Lyric Video
snippet.description:
Ahead of their forthcoming 30th anniversary tour Placebo have released a brand new single  ‘Helen Keller’ via Elevator Lady Ltd / So Recordings.
 
New single Helen Keller sees Placebo hark back to their self-titled debut and its hidden track  H.K. Farewell. Rather than revisiting the original recording, the band have created an entirely  new song, referencing the keyboard melody from H.K Farewell as its foundation. The track  takes it in a fresh direction, retaining the haunting character of the original melody while adding  the raw angst the band are known for. The new single, which was recorded in London earlier  this year, was produced by Placebo and Adam Noble and mixed by Adam Noble.
Speaking about the new single Brian explains: ‘‘This is a new rock song inspired by the piano  melody from H.K. Farewell and named after one of my favourite people from history.” 

This new release follows on from their recent Placebo RE:CREATED album, released this  summer - a powerful new reworking of the record that first introduced them to the world in  1996. Thirty years on, Placebo RE:CREATED saw the band return to this pivotal album with  a fresh perspective. The new record featured reworked and embellished versions of all ten  tracks from the original album plus two bonus tracks from the original release, capturing the  way these songs have evolved across decades of performance while retaining the raw spirit  that defined them. 

Today sees Placebo embark on their extensive UK and European arena tour to celebrate this  momentous anniversary. The band will be exclusively performing songs from their first two  albums, Placebo and Without You I’m Nothing - some of which have not been performed live  for over 20 years. The tour kicks off in Portugal today before heading across Europe and  ending in the UK, seeing them perform to hundreds of thousands of fans across 36 dates.  Earlier this month Placebo also announced a forthcoming 2027 Latin America tour which kicks  off February 20th in São Paulo before making three additional stops in Brazil. From there, the  band will visit Buenos Aires, Santiago, Lima, and Bogotá before wrapping the run with shows  in Guadalajara and Monterrey in March. 

Placebo RE:CREATED is available across a range of physical formats, including 1CD, 2CD,  Cassette, a Box Set, and five vinyl variants including a Picture Disc. All available here: https://placebo.ffm.to/recreated.OYD

localized.description:
Ahead of their forthcoming 30th anniversary tour Placebo have released a brand new single  ‘Helen Keller’ via Elevator Lady Ltd / So Recordings.
 
New single Helen Keller sees Placebo hark back to their self-titled debut and its hidden track  H.K. Farewell. Rather than revisiting the original recording, the band have created an entirely  new song, referencing the keyboard melody from H.K Farewell as its foundation. The track  takes it in a fresh direction, retaining the haunting character of the original melody while adding  the raw angst the band are known for. The new single, which was recorded in London earlier  this year, was produced by Placebo and Adam Noble and mixed by Adam Noble.
Speaking about the new single Brian explains: ‘‘This is a new rock song inspired by the piano  melody from H.K. Farewell and named after one of my favourite people from history.” 

This new release follows on from their recent Placebo RE:CREATED album, released this  summer - a powerful new reworking of the record that first introduced them to the world in  1996. Thirty years on, Placebo RE:CREATED saw the band return to this pivotal album with  a fresh perspective. The new record featured reworked and embellished versions of all ten  tracks from the original album plus two bonus tracks from the original release, capturing the  way these songs have evolved across decades of performance while retaining the raw spirit  that defined them. 

Today sees Placebo embark on their extensive UK and European arena tour to celebrate this  momentous anniversary. The band will be exclusively performing songs from their first two  albums, Placebo and Without You I’m Nothing - some of which have not been performed live  for over 20 years. The tour kicks off in Portugal today before heading across Europe and  ending in the UK, seeing them perform to hundreds of thousands of fans across 36 dates.  Earlier this month Placebo also announced a forthcoming 2027 Latin America tour which kicks  off February 20th in São Paulo before making three additional stops in Brazil. From there, the  band will visit Buenos Aires, Santiago, Lima, and Bogotá before wrapping the run with shows  in Guadalajara and Monterrey in March.

snippet.description:
#JurassicWorld #DarkTerritory #ConceptTrailer

Watch this Jurassic World: Dark Territory Concept Trailer and enter a hidden volcanic island where a new dinosaur preserve turns into a fight for survival.

Matt Damon stars as Commander Dante Shaw, an ex-military security consultant sent to Isla Tremor to test the defenses of a secret dinosaur facility before it opens.
Ryan Gosling plays geneticist Dr. Victor Ashford, while Amanda Seyfried and Elle Fanning join the expedition as scientists witnessing the island's living prehistoric world firsthand.
When a violent volcanic tremor destroys the containment systems, T-Rex, Velociraptors, and a terrifying engineered apex predator known as The Tremor escape into the jungle.

This What If concept imagines a darker Jurassic World survival story filled with collapsing facilities, dinosaur attacks, volcanic destruction, and a desperate race toward the island's last evacuation point.

As Shaw leads the survivors toward the north shore, Ashford returns alone to activate the emergency beacon while Isla Tremor begins tearing itself apart around them.
The final escape comes at a devastating cost, but the real danger begins after the rescue when dinosaurs are seen swimming away from the burning island into the open Pacific.
The storyboard, original storyline, scene concepts, and visuals were personally created by me specifically for this What If concept trailer and its cinematic world.
